title: Emit repo-relative path on task view/list JSON records
description: lore-cli LCLI-428: lore sync drops hyperlinks from managed <!-- lore:tasks --> blocks because its adapter (src/adapters/quest.ts:607) already reads value.file ?? value.path, and quest never emits either. Decision made 2026-09-03 answering an opum-agent orchestrator query: emit path (not file) on both task view and task list, since lore already falls back to path with zero adapter change needed. Compute it from the already-known TaskLocation (tasks/completed/archive/tasks) using the same rule as the existing ownedPathForLocation helper (src/application/tasks/tasks.ts:577-578): .quest/${location}/${id}.json. Additive field only -- no TRACKER_CONTRACT_VERSION bump, no change to required-field subset checks elsewhere.

acceptanceCriteria.text: quest task view <id> --json includes data.path with the record's current repo-relative path (.quest/tasks/<id>.json, .quest/completed/<id>.json, or .quest/archive/tasks/<id>.json depending on status)
quest task list --json includes path on every list item using the same rule, with no extra filesystem I/O beyond what list already does
src/contract/tracker/index.ts required-fields manifests (and matching fixtures) list path for both task list and task view

A code comment or doc note states path reflects current location and can change when a task's status moves it across directories -- callers that persist it (e.g. rendered links) must expect staleness after such a transition
Existing task view/list tests pass plus new coverage asserting the correct path for a task in each of the three locations

plan: Add TaskStateWithPath alongside TaskState; add TaskService.viewWithPath/listFilteredWithPath computed from the already-tracked TaskLocation without touching view()/listFiltered() (their plain results feed write paths elsewhere, e.g. lifecycle journal replay, that must never see a synthetic field).
Wire dispatchTrackerTaskCommand's view/list cases to the WithPath variants; add path to the public TrackerSummary contract type and isSummary validator.

Add path to the required-field manifests in all three copies that must stay in sync: src/contract/tracker/index.ts, src/contract/tracker/fixtures.ts, src/application/command-contract.ts (plus the golden-manifest test in test/contract/command-contract.test.ts).
Add coverage in test/integration/tasks/cli-semantics.test.ts asserting the exact path for a task in each of tasks/completed/archive-tasks, via task view and task list --include-archived.
implementationNotes: Shipped 2026-09-04. Field is path (not file); lore-cli's adapter already reads value.file ?? value.path, so no lore-side change is needed for this to work.

Path is derived at read time from the record's real on-disk location (scanned across tasks/completed/archive/tasks), never from id+status -- this matters because task edit --status <terminal> does NOT relocate the file the way task complete does (verified in tasks.ts: complete()/archive() call moveTask(), editOn() never does), so two tasks with the same terminal status can legitimately sit in different directories. Filed that inconsistency separately (QCLI-221) rather than folding a lifecycle-semantics fix into this contract change.
bun run check passes (typecheck, lint, format, layer check, full test suite: 399 pass).
finalSummary: Emits path on both task view --json and task list --json: a repo-relative string naming the record's current JSON file (.quest/tasks|completed|archive/tasks/<id>.json), computed from the TaskService's existing per-record TaskLocation tracking, additive to the manifest contract (no TRACKER_CONTRACT_VERSION bump). Verified via: bun run check (399 tests pass) and new integration coverage asserting the exact path across all three lifecycle locations for both task view and task list --include-archived.
